CASA Releases Open Weather Data Feed for London

Andy CASA, UCL East

We are providing open access to our live weather data - here at the Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis, University College London.  The station is located on the roof of 1-19 Torrington Place, off Tottenham Court Road in Central London (map link).

The data is provided via a Davis Vantage Pro 2 with fan assisted radiation shield and UV/Solar sensors. Using the ever excellent Weather Display software we are able to provide 4 data files accessible via our servers: http://www.casa.ucl.ac.uk/weather/clientraw.txt - updates every 3 seconds. http://www.casa.ucl.ac.uk/weather/clientrawextra.txt http://www.casa.ucl.ac.uk/weather/clientrawdaily.txt http://www.casa.ucl.ac.uk/weather/clientrawhour.txt Below is an example data dump with tags created via the ClientRaw Parser The data can be freely used with the following attribute 'Data provided by Digitalurban, via The Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis, University College London'.
